description: Recommend streaming Semiotic charts for a schema (not row data). Pass fields (with optional cardinality and additive hints) plus optional throughput (band or rows/sec), retention, shape ('append'|'keyed'|'aggregate'), and keyFields. Ranks realtime XY charts plus push-capable ordinal/value/xy charts (BarChart, PieChart, Scatterplot, BigNumber, GaugeChart, …). Returns suggestions, excluded fits-reasons, the ranking intents (inferred when none is given), schema warnings, and optional stretch picks when audience is set.

schema.description: Stream schema — fields plus throughput/retention/shape hints. No row data.

additive.description: Whether summing the measure across events is meaningful (counts, amounts, changes) or not (prices, latencies, percentages).

cardinality.description: Expected distinct values for a categorical, boolean, or key field.

name: suggestStreamCharts
